correctness.rationale: Frozen balanced-target matching ODE was reconstructed: capped stationarity gives C(x)=sum min(c_i,x) and D(y), both strictly increasing until T, and a scalar K=C^{-1}(R)D^{-1}(R)/R which is strictly increasing on 0<R<T. Full target R=T gives the exactly feasible A interval [d_max/K,T/c_max]; singleton at K_c=c_max d_max/T and a continuum above. The top multiplicities yield epsilon=T-R and the one-sided slope 1/(K_c eta), eta=1/(m_c c_max)+1/(m_d d_max)-1/T>0. At interior full-target points, within-side fluctuation modes and the aggregate 2x2 Jacobian have one zero tangent and all other negative eigenvalues. For homogeneous targets and within-side identical starts, constant A-B before clipping and boundary saturation give the selected clipped h0. Independent rational checks tested 12 interior/end equilibria and three cusp approximations; this finite sample is not the all-target proof.

value.rationale: Balanced total desired rates are the natural degeneracy hyperplane omitted from the originating model. Identifying the exact K_c, complete heterogeneous equilibrium geometry and quantitative cusp distinguishes feasibility from perpetual target shortfall; the neutral manifold and selected homogeneous outcome give useful dynamics that cannot be read from a numerical equilibrium plot. This is a structural classification, not a routine relabeling of the unequal-total theorem.
